encounters.cc: Lightheadedness and weakness after completing outdoor half-marathon in hot weather without hydration.

lines: Lightheadedness and weakness after completing outdoor half-marathon in hot weather without hydration.

The patient presents to the emergency department with recurrent symptoms in the context of known bulimia nervosa, purging type, and history of diuretic and laxative misuse, having been previously evaluated for loop diuretic toxicity and anabolic steroid abuse.
She participates in an outdoor half-marathon on a hot summer day.
She has not had anything to eat or drink since the previous evening and forgot to bring water for the run.
Around the ninth mile, she begins feeling lightheaded and weak but pushes through the final stretch.
After crossing the finish line, she sits down and reports feeling her heart racing and some blurriness in her vision.
A friend offers her water, but she declines, saying she feels too nauseated.
On standing, she becomes dizzy and needs assistance to remain upright.
- Psychogenic urinary retention due to acute stress reaction (diagnosed 2021-01-15)
- History of anabolic steroid use disorder
- History of laxative and diuretic misuse
- Maternal aunt with binge eating disorder
Alcohol: None (avoids due to calorie concerns).
She denies chest pain or shortness of breath.
Radial pulse is rapid and thready
She is alert and oriented but appears visibly fatigued and mildly disoriented.
Her extremities are warm but show a delayed capillary refill time.
There is no visible bleeding or trauma.
Physical examination shows dry mucous membranes and a slightly delayed pupillary response to light.
Cardiac and pulmonary auscultation are unremarkable.
A tilt-table test reveals a substantial increase in heart rate upon standing.

encounters.cc: Intractable nausea and vomiting ten times daily with 4 kg weight loss over two weeks during pregnancy.

lines: Intractable nausea and vomiting ten times daily with 4 kg weight loss over two weeks during pregnancy.
The patient is a 27-year-old female with bulimia nervosa, purging type, and a history of laxative and diuretic misuse who returns two months after her prior hyperemesis gravidarum admission.
She states that she vomits “ten times a day,” cannot keep any food or fluids down, and feels weak and dizzy.
She has lost 4 kg (9 lb) over the past two weeks.
Her prenatal course has been otherwise unremarkable, and when asked why this is happening, she says, “Why am I the only one of my friends who’s pregnant and throwing up nonstop?”
- Psychogenic urinary retention due to acute stress reaction (diagnosed 2021-01-15)
- Hypochloremic metabolic alkalosis secondary to vomiting with hypovolemia (diagnosed 2022-01-15)
- History of anabolic steroid use disorder
- History of laxative and diuretic misuse

- Maternal aunt with binge eating disorder

She appears fatigued and has dry mucous membranes.
A urine dipstick shows moderate ketones.
Bedside ultrasound confirms a viable singleton intrauterine pregnancy.

encounters.cc: Found confused and disoriented at music festival after drinking excessive water and taking ecstasy.

lines: Found confused and disoriented at music festival after drinking excessive water and taking ecstasy.

This 28-year-old female with a history of bulimia nervosa, purging type, and prior emergency department visits for dehydration, diuretic toxicity, and metabolic alkalosis secondary to vomiting, is brought to the emergency department by her friends after she was found confused and disoriented at a music festival.
She has been drinking large amounts of water throughout the day to stay hydrated in the hot weather.
Her friends also mention that she has taken an ecstasy pill earlier in the day.

- Hypochloremic metabolic alkalosis secondary to vomiting with hypovolemia (diagnosed 2022-01-15)
